info.desc: "GLOW ON" is the third studio album by the American punk rock band Turnstile, released on August 27, 2021, via Roadrunner Records. The album was recorded in summer 2020 at Phantom Studios in Gallatin, Tennessee. It was recorded by American producer Mike Elizondo, and marks as the band's first release to include a featured artist with a guest appearance from British singer/songwriter and producer Blood Orange. It is the band's last album to feature founding guitarist Brady Ebert, who departed from the band in August 2022. "GLOW ON" received universal critical acclaim and was named the best album of 2021 .

podcast.body: Released in 2021, this album features the song "Blackout." Turnstile is described as a Baltimore-based group with serious hardcore roots, but which is also taking their sound in a more experimental direction. "This is a song called Blackout from the 2021 album, Blow On."
